BEFORE YOU BUY
What exactly will I learn?

How to choose a ready-made mold, estimate quantities, make solid chocolate discs, practise open shells and prepare frozen fruit inserts. You also get troubleshooting and printable worksheets.

Is the guide in English or Italian?

There are two separate editions with the same 24-page structure. The language switch opens the matching preview. The €19 guide includes both editions.

Does it include the blue bonbon recipe?

No. The blue bonbon and sculptural dessert photos are AI visual concepts. The lessons use plain chocolate and a fruit-insert exercise. They do not claim to reproduce the styled cover desserts.

Do I make the silicone mold myself?

No. This volume starts with ready-made food molds. Silicone manufacture, filled-bonbon formulation and complete mousse recipes are outside its scope.

Can I order materials or a custom mold?

Not yet. Custom molds, materials and kits are marked Coming soon. The digital guide is our first product.
